en: A black and white photograph showing a boy sitting at the edge of a quay or dock, facing the water, with a sailboat named 'Leila' in the background. The sun is low over the horizon, suggesting either early morning or late afternoon. The scene is tranquil, with the silhouette of the boy and the boat creating a nostalgic atmosphere. The lower left contains the word 'Varbergspojk.', and there is attribution text in the lower right corner.
